instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use standard React (.js) with functional components and tailwindcss. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Apply Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast). Do not use soft shadows (shadow-sm/md/lg); instead use brutalist solid drop shadows like shadow-[8px_8px_0_0_#18181b].
Enforce sharp corners by using 'rounded-none' everywhere. DO NOT use rounded corners anywhere.
Use 'Chivo' font for all headings (h1, h2, h3). Use 'Work Sans' for body text. Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for uppercase labels, button texts, price numbers, and badges.

The middle card ('Suscripción') MUST stand out. Apply an inverted color scheme to it: bg-zinc-900, white text, and an accent border/shadow (blue-600). Make it physically pop out slightly by adding '-translate-y-4' on desktop.

Ensure all features in the list use 'lucide-react' icons. For 'Gratis' plan, render an 'X' or 'Minus' icon (text-zinc-400) for 'Sin opción de exportar'. For others, use a 'Check' icon (text-blue-600 or text-zinc-900).

Add a striking 'AI Models' section below the pricing grid. Display the 4 models (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT 4.1, MiniMax M2.7, MiMo-V2-Pro) using a technical/brutalist grid of minimalist boxes or a scrolling marquee with IBM Plex Mono font.
Use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements, specifically buttons, as specified in the content block.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere on the page.
Do not import external image URLs. Use CSS shapes, stark typography, and lucide-react icons for the visual 'spectacular' feel.
Write the page entirely in Spanish as requested.
